sources.title: 答李翊书
sources.edition: 全唐文卷552 via Chinese Text Project
sources.notes: Directly describes long-term study, removing stale/borrowed expression, filtering mixed language, and the relation between qi and verbal rhythm. Received text, not autograph manuscript.

sources.title: 答李翊书
sources.notes: Corroborating edition; must not be double-counted as an independent Episode source.

sources.title: 答刘正夫书
sources.notes: Explicitly answers what to imitate in ancient writers and whether prose should be easy or difficult.

sources.title: 与冯宿论文书
sources.notes: First-person contrast between writing Han Yu judges good and contemporary audience approval of conventional writing.

sources.title: 答尉迟生书
sources.notes: Discusses relation between what is within the writer and what appears in language, while still requiring sufficient diction for completed prose.

sources.title: 南阳樊绍述墓志铭
sources.notes: Praises writing that originates from the writer rather than repeating predecessors, while also valuing orderly and functional wording.

sources.title: 送孟东野序
sources.notes: Develops the idea that expression is triggered by pressure or imbalance; useful as a candidate lens, not automatically a revision rule.
